sourceAssertions: No production source changed from the SB10 proof head to the SB11 implementation commit.
ProviderBackedLlmStreamingInvocationAdapter retains incremental delivery, completed fallback labelling, and the no-retry-after-delta boundary.
The PostgreSQL event store remains the durable monotonic replay authority; Web remains only the typed SSE transport owner.
The real-host slow-provider test now observes a real endpoint heartbeat while the operation remains nonterminal.
The isolated-output test locator accepts the standard CANDOITALL_TEST_REPOSITORY_ROOT identity and rejects an invalid configured path explicitly.
No production LLM Chat partial, forbidden reference, schema change, alternate executor, or UI dependency was added.
behavioralCases: OpenAI Chat Completions/Responses and Azure SSE plus Ollama NDJSON parse fragmented UTF-8 and protocol terminal frames without live provider calls
completed-only drivers emit one CompletedFallback delta/completion and existing non-streaming callers remain compatible
PostgreSQL admission/finalization atomicity, profile fencing, distributed leases, remote cancellation, event sequence, retention, transfer, migration, and bounded reads pass
real-host turn admission returns 202 before the slow provider completes and publishes incremental delta plus heartbeat
Last-Event-ID reconnect avoids duplicate text and redispatch, retained-history gap points to status, and success/cancel/failure each close with one terminal event
exact authorization scopes, server-owned Api origin, stable v1 envelopes, and secret/error redaction remain green on Linux
negativeCases: retry before first delta is allowed, but a visible delta prevents retry and partial failure creates no canonical assistant message
rollback publishes no event and stale profile/lease owners cannot finalize
request/SSE disconnect does not cancel or redispatch the durable operation; explicit cancellation does
conflicting cursors, stale revisions, duplicate operation bodies, malformed provider frames, and raw provider secrets fail predictably
invalid configured repository root fails rather than silently searching another checkout
nuget.org-only cold restore remains red until the exact Spreadsheet package is published or the dependency source is corrected
